page.overview:
Who is Angler Fish?

The is the of in . It is the guarding the . The is fought underwater and charges at , making rocky tiles fall down from the ceiling upon hitting a wall. will also appear to aid it. can defeat it by slashing its light with the .

The is the of in . It is battled in one of the underground, side-scrolling areas of the , with a bumpy ground that must use the to traverse. The will move back and forth through the room while continually bouncing off the ground, up to the height of the ceiling. It will periodically fire harmful, slow-moving bubbles toward , which can bounce off the room's surfaces and accumulate. These bubbles can be popped with the and will sometimes drop or ; otherwise they will eventually pop on their own.

In the , the appears as the boss of the . While fighting it, breaks his after stabbing its head, defeating it in the process.

The is named after the real-life , which it strongly resembles.
